human_summary: Evidence from The Daily Star and a video report from Ekattor TV describe a fatal bus crash on the Bogura-Naogaon regional highway near Erulia Bazar in Bogura Sadar upazila. The Daily Star reports that a speeding bus ran over labourers waiting for work around 5:30 am, killing seven; the video report confirms seven fatalities. The bus, operated by Shah Fateh Ali Paribahan, had reportedly been running without a route permit for one and a half years per BRTA. A fire service officer stated that brake failure occurred when the bus gave way to a motorcycle, after which it struck an electricity pole and then hit the labourers. Authorities formed a three-member committee led by Additional District Magistrate Masud Hossain to investigate; compensation of Tk 25,000 per deceased and Tk 15,000 per injured was announced. Locals blocked the road demanding speed breakers, and the Roads and Highways Department promised installation. The crash killed seven and injured an unspecified number; the broader article mentions 16 deaths and 48 injuries across Sylhet and Bogura, but this incident-specific count is seven. The exact crash coordinates remain unknown; geolocation is based on city-level centroid. [ev_3d9b6f7ef1b8f36b, ev_7d10439deaca950c, ev_b02f78dc220fb6ca, ev_35ec9cf7714b6c1c]
